header.eyebrow: Consumers Kitchen & Bath · Product Selector guide
header.title: From a product on a vendor's website to a priced special-order line on the estimate
header.lede: Where each step happens: on the vendor's own website with the customer, in the Consumers QuickAdd browser extension (Edge or Chrome), in the Product Selector on the sales PC, and in NetSuite. Click any numbered box to read its exact buttons.
header.meta: Mapped from the code on 11/5/2026: Product Selector Special Order page, Quote List and the Consumers QuickAdd extension 1.5.3 (1.5.4 on 11/6: newest copy wins; 1.5.5: kits split into parts, Flusso finish squares; 1.5.6: kits on every vendor after sweep 2).

parts.title: Vendor site to estimate
parts.intro: The customer picks products on the vendor's own website; the Consumers QuickAdd extension carries each pick to the Product Selector, where the rep finishes it as a special order and pushes it to the estimate.
parts.caption: Read top to bottom. The dashed arrow is optional (adding more products). A dashed round box sends you to another way of doing the step.

nodes.label: Once per PC, ahead of time: install Consumers QuickAdd
nodes.detail: In the Product Selector, click your name, then QuickAdd, and click Download. Extract the zip, go to edge://extensions (Chrome: chrome://extensions), turn on Developer mode, click Load unpacked and choose the consumers-quote-helper folder. The QuickAdd page then says it is installed, and later tells you when there is a newer version. If a browser has two copies (an old hand-loaded one and the Group Policy one), only the newer copy shows its button (1.5.4), but remove the old one anyway.

nodes.label: Sign in to the Product Selector
nodes.detail: Sign in with your NetSuite email and webstore password on the same PC and browser that has QuickAdd.

nodes.label: QuickAdd turns on for the vendor sites
nodes.detail: The Product Selector sends every special-order product line's website (the PRD page's website link in NetSuite). QuickAdd works only on those vendor domains and does nothing on other sites.

nodes.label: Click SPECIAL ORDER, then a category
nodes.detail: In the menu click SPECIAL ORDER. Under Browse by category pick one, for example Plumbing: Faucets. The PRODUCT LINES cards for that category show.

nodes.label: Click a product line card: Shop vendor site
nodes.detail: Each card with a website says Shop vendor site. Clicking it opens the vendor's website in a new tab, for the customer to browse.

nodes.label: Customer opens a product on the vendor site
nodes.detail: The customer browses the vendor's site as usual and opens the product page they want.

nodes.label: QuickAdd read the item from the page?
nodes.detail: The Add to CPS Quote List button shows at the bottom right on every page of a product line's vendor site, and reads the page again on each click. On a product page QuickAdd fills in the model, name and usually the price: from the page's product data, or from the model and price printed next to the product name. On Fleurco it reads the model and total once every configurator choice is made; a build of several items (a door with a base, drain or Mix & Match Kit) is split into its parts, each at its own price (1.5.5). Since 1.5.6 the same goes for Brizo combos and trims with their rough, Kohler and Delta bundles, Grohe required rough-ins, TOTO add-ons, Bain Ultra drain kits and options, Sofia accessories and John Boos add-ons.

nodes.label: Customer types the model and color in the panel
nodes.detail: A page with nothing to read (Avance's door styles, or Fleurco's shower door configurator before every choice is made) opens the panel with the page's name and a blank Model, with a note saying what to do. Type the model number and color shown on the page.

nodes.label: Check Type, model, finish, Coll/Desc, quantity; click Add to quote
nodes.detail: Choose the Option (color or finish) if the page does not say; picking another finish on the page greys the panel out with an Updating... spinner until it shows the new finish. Check the Type (the best fit is preselected), Model, Color / finish, Collection / Description (one field, as NetSuite's Coll/Desc), Price on this site and Quantity, then click Add to quote. Some sites show no price (Elkay, Franke, Richelieu, Strategic Brands); the rep enters the list price. A Fleurco kit shows one block per part and Add 4 items to quote puts each part on the Quote List as its own line.

nodes.label: Pick waits in QuickAdd for the sales rep
nodes.detail: The panel says Added to the CPS Quote List. N items waiting for your sales rep. The toolbar icon shows the count; its popup lists the waiting items and has Clear waiting items.

nodes.label: Pick lands on the Quote List, Type suggested
nodes.detail: With the Product Selector open and signed in, each pick goes straight onto the Quote List as a special-order line: model, description, color, list price and quantity from the vendor page, the Type guessed from the product name, and a Picked on link to the vendor page. A pick whose site has several product lines (Foremost) waits on the Special Order page under Picked on vendor websites instead; Use fills in the form there.

nodes.label: Line shows an amber Needs ...?
nodes.detail: When the vendor page did not show everything NetSuite needs (a Type the name does not settle, a Color, the list price), the line says what is missing, and the Quote List will not push until it is done.

nodes.label: Click Needs ...: the form opens with the pick
nodes.detail: The Edit Special Order form opens with the product line, model, description, color and quantity filled in, and a link to the vendor page. The list price is blank when the page showed none.

nodes.label: Fill in what is missing, check the list price, click Save Changes
nodes.detail: Pick the Type if it is blank, type the Color or Model, and check the List Price: a vendor site can show a sale price (Delta Outlet items, for example). Price As starts on Retail.

nodes.label: Pick cleared from QuickAdd
nodes.detail: As soon as it is on the Quote List, the pick leaves QuickAdd's waiting list and the counts go down.

nodes.label: Quote List: type 3 digits of the estimate, select it
nodes.detail: Under Push to NetSuite Estimate type at least 3 digits of the estimate number (the ES is optional). The search runs by itself; click the open estimate.

nodes.label: Click Push Items to Estimate
nodes.detail: If the estimate's customer is the other type (Retail or CRD) than a line's Price As, a note says it will be priced at the estimate's type.

nodes.label: Special-order lines on the estimate, priced as in NetSuite
nodes.detail: Each line gets list price x the product line's multipliers for the estimate's customer (Retail or CRD), with its Type, Model, Coll/Desc and Color.

gapsIntro: What this process needs that the app or QuickAdd does not do yet.

gaps.title: Some pages leave fields for the customer.
gaps.text: QuickAdd reads the item on 17 special-order vendor sites (checked page by page on 11/5/2026, about 230 product pages). Avance pages are door styles with no model numbers, so the customer types the model. Richelieu, Strategic Brands, Franke and Craft & Main show no price to the public, so the rep enters the list price. Configurators (Fleurco, Sofia, Bain Ultra) fill in once every choice is made.

gaps.title: Picks stay in one browser.
gaps.text: QuickAdd keeps picks on the PC where they were made. A customer browsing on their own phone or tablet cannot send picks, and the extension does not run on an iPad.

gaps.title: Picks are not tied to a customer.
gaps.text: Everything added on a PC lands in one waiting list. If two customers use the same PC, the rep has to tell their picks apart.

gaps.title: The Type is only suggested when the name settles it.
gaps.text: QuickAdd suggests the Type from the product name, the breadcrumbs and the vendor address (34 of 34 sweep cases right). When two Types fit equally the customer picks it; the panel requires it. Order-form Types (Bain Ultra tubs) go to NetSuite as Per Attached Order Form, so the rep attaches the vendor order form. Craft & Main shower bases and walls have no Type in NetSuite yet.

gaps.title: New vendor sites need a QuickAdd release for the built-in list.
gaps.text: QuickAdd goes to every PC by Group Policy and updates itself from the Product Selector. A product line made special-order in NetSuite works as soon as the Product Selector is open in that browser; the list built into QuickAdd (used before that) is refreshed with each release.

tips: After installing QuickAdd, open the Product Selector once while signed in so it gets the current vendor sites. The QuickAdd page (your name, then QuickAdd) shows whether this browser has it and if it is up to date.
QuickAdd's toolbar icon shows how many picks are waiting; its popup lists them and can clear them.
When a vendor's website changes, update the product line's website on its PRD page in NetSuite; QuickAdd follows the next time the Product Selector is open.
A vendor site can show a sale price. The list price is what counts, so always check it before Add to List.
